p: blessed him: This second blessing was to confirm Jacob's faith, lest he should think that his father had given it without God's leading.
stranger: The godly fathers were continually reminded that they were but strangers in this world: so that they would lift up their eyes to the heavens where they have a certain dwelling.
Ishmael Abraham's son: Thinking by this to have reconciled himself to his father, but all in vain: for he does not take away the cause of the evil.
ladder set up on the earth: Christ is the ladder by which God and man are joined together, and by whom the angels minister to us: all graces are given to us by him, and we ascend to heaven by him.
will I give it: He felt the force of this promise only by faith: for all his life he was a stranger in this land.
afraid: He was touched with a godly fear and reverence.
set it up for a pillar: To be a reminder of the vision shown to him.
God will be with me: He does not bind God under this condition, but acknowledges his infirmity, and promises to be thankful.
